top_signals.title: Wall St Surges Toward M&A Record as Megadeals Defy Selloff
top_signals.summary: Wall Street is taking a big step toward a record year for mergers and acquisitions as some of the world’s largest companies defy a tech-induced selloff in global stocks to pursue major takeovers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Tech Companies Are Getting More Creative to Raise Billions
top_signals.summary: The biggest tech companies are increasingly finding that to borrow the hundreds of billions of dollars they want to fund artificial intelligence investments, they need to get creative.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Refinery in Southern Russia Halts Operations After Attack
top_signals.summary: A small refinery in southern Russia suspended operations following a drone strike as Moscow and Kyiv continued to trade attacks on each other’s energy infrastructure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
